blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A five-year-old boy, who was reported to have been abducted in Calamba City in Laguna, was safely reunited with his family after he was found in the Rizal town of Tanay on Thursday. Calamba City police said a concerned citizen found the child crying outside San Ildefonso Church in Barangay Aldea and had immediately reported it to local police, according to a report on Friday (October 23). Officers from the Women and Children Protection Desk (WCPD) brought the boy to the police station and provided him food and appropriate care.
